scope: Residual shared descriptor ioctl discovery/control: original OFD acceptance, namespace type, virtual render discovery, implemented interface queries/link changes, unsupported-command errors, source/solo ABI, policy and lifetime.

architecture.common_abi: The original canonical ioctl body is shared by solo and source. Network and render routines accept the same CpuMemory; no duplicate device ABI is introduced.
architecture.acceptance: The existing per-task sealed PathQueries resolver accepts one original shared OFD. Its existing private retained-descriptor scope supplies all accesses and restores the alias even on unwind. No guest-visible descriptor is installed.
architecture.resources: Original Files, namespace/network topology and credentials. PTY job controls and FIONBIO/FIOASYNC retain their existing accepted endpoint/status/signal execution.
architecture.errors: Unsupported controls preserve canonical ENOTTY, missing/O_PATH descriptors preserve EBADF, and original guest copyout/partial-write/privilege ordering is retained. Missing legacy providers remain before-effects fallback.
architecture.performance: Only residual controls use this route; ordinary byte/native paths gain no check, fence, thread, global lock or queue. It reuses the captured resolver and actual shared resources.
architecture.policy: New controls participate in the existing retained seccomp decision route; excluded resources keep their entry token before fallback.

One connected process regression runs four/twelve CPUs and one execution slot, including an allowed seccomp filter and non-terminal TCSETS. Initial filtered routing omissions were found and fixed before final checks.

Test setup initially omitted render opt-in and namespace process metadata, and attempted unsupported root-loopback down controls. These are test setup failures, not production findings.
